scope: Selected STL-1 training rings; front sculpted-face region versus top and isometric source images
review_basis: Direct visual inspection of the three original front, top and isometric render triplets

status_vocabulary.recognizable_partial: Some recognizable detail from the annotated front region is visible, but no point-level identity is asserted
status_vocabulary.no_recognizable_detail: The annotated front detail cannot be recognized in this target image; physical occlusion and geometry are not inferred

top.note: The top image shows the shank and reverse/profile of the head, not the deity's facial features.

iso.note: The side of the face, crown and adjacent relief are recognizable.

top.note: The top image shows the shank and rear of the head; front facial features are not recognizable.

iso.note: The angled image shows the crown and part of the face.

top.note: The top image shows the shank and rear of the relief assembly, not the central facial features.

iso.note: The angled image shows a narrow but recognizable side of the sculpted face.

limitations: These three selected training rings are not a random or held-out accuracy sample.
The bbox is an approximate visual region for review, not a pixel-accurate segmentation.
No image-only review proves physical occlusion, exact 3D coordinates or metric scale.
A target-view status does not certify or reject any individual reciprocal track.
